title: Apple patches CVE-2026-86950, an out-of-bounds write in CoreGraphics that may have been exploited in targeted attacks
content_md:
Apple has released an update for CVE-2026-86950, an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may have been exploited in targeted attacks.

via Mastodon https://linuxmint.hu/hir/2026/09/celzott-tamadasban-is-kihasznalhattak-az-apple-serulekenyseget
